text:
maria: Quick sync — prepping the new llama-v2-13b variant for onboarding. Weight upload is done but I want a config sanity-check before I open the PR.

sahil: thanks — where are the weights? path?

maria: s3://redwood-models/llama-v2-13b/2026-03-16/weights.tar.gz

oliver: noted. tokenizer note: this repo's tokenizer uses byte-level bpe but the repo default eos_id=1, model expects eos_id=2 — saw truncation in local evals. @maria can you confirm tokenizer.json from the artifact?

maria: confirmed, tokenizer.json still has eos_id: 1. I regenerated with eos_id=2 and pushed tokenizer/* to the same s3 prefix.

kevin: quick config question — the serving config currently sets continuous_batching: { max_batch_tokens: 2048, batch_timeout_ms: 16 } . For this model with a 8k context we saw kv-cache thrash. Suggest lowering max_batch_tokens to 1024 and bumping scheduler.max_concurrent_requests to 40 for dedicated pools. Thoughts?

oliver: agree on lowering max_batch_tokens. Also enable prefix_cache: { enabled: true, size: 5000 } for expected repeating prompts — helps with short-response workloads.

maria: added these changes locally. here's the snippet I plan to put in the PR: 
```
serving: 
  model: llama-v2-13b
  continuous_batching:
    enabled: true
    max_batch_tokens: 1024
    batch_timeout_ms: 12
  caching:
    prefix_cache:
      enabled: true
      size: 5000
      ttl_ms: 3600000
  scheduler:
    max_concurrent_requests: 40
    fairness_policy: throughput_first
  generation:
    max_tokens: 4096
```

sahil: quick validation: schema check failed locally with "generation.max_tokens > model.max_context" when I ran the onboarding linter. model.max_context is 8192 so we're fine, but the linter flagged because default was 2048 in the template. Make sure to bump model context in model-metadata.json.

maria: added model-metadata.json update with context=8192 in the artifact. Will attach to PR.

kevin: Can you include a small unit test for tokenizer edge-case? A sample prompt that previously dropped the last token because of eos mismatch. That helps CI catch regressions.

maria: added test + test vectors under tests/tokenizer/ (two short prompts) — references in PR description.

oliver: pinging infra — @deploy-bot can you schedule a canary on staging with these settings? low traffic shard first. :eyes:

deploy-bot: canary rollout queued: job_id=cr-20260316-77, targeting staging/shard-3, concurrency=5, watch: 15m. I will post status.

kevin: PR ready? drop link and I'll do a quick review.

maria: opened PR #4273 — includes weights pointer, tokenizer fix, config tweaks, tests, and a short note on expected perf tradeoffs.

oliver: LGTM on config changes. minor nit on yaml formatting.

sahil: will run the onboarding linter + quick perf smoke tomorrow morning and report back.

maria: thanks all — leaving the rest async. if anyone sees odd latency after canary starts, notify #eng-runtime immediately. :thumbsup:
